description: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.In this pivotal role, you will oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and driving continuous improvement in quality outcomes. You will be instrumental in shaping the future of the center, guiding a dedicated team, and upholding the highest standards of operational excellence.This position offers a highly competitive salary package, reflecting the significant impact and responsibility of the role. Join a team committed to making a difference in the lives of those they serve.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Proven leadership experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Demonstrated ability to manage financial performance, operational efficiency, and quality assurance programs.
Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and team-building skills.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Missouri Valley, IA. In this vital role, you will be responsible for the comprehensive assessment and care planning process, ensuring regulatory compliance and high-quality resident care. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented RN to make a significant impact within a supportive environment.As an MDS Coordinator, you will play a crucial role in coordinating the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process, including the timely and accurate completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS), Care Area Assessments (CAAs), and individualized care plans. Your expertise will ensure that residents receive appropriate and person-centered care, while also maintaining compliance with all federal and state regulations.This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $65,000 - $75,000 per year. We are looking for a permanent team member who is committed to long-term success and resident well-being.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Comprehensive knowledge of the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process, including MDS 3.0
Familiarity with Medicare and Medicaid regulations related to skilled nursing care
Strong organizational, assessment, and documentation skills

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Red Bay, AL. This is an exceptional opportunity for an RN looking to make a significant impact on patient care during the evening and night hours, working consistent 12-hour shifts.

In this vital role, you will be responsible for providing high-quality nursing care, administering medications, monitoring patient conditions, and collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to ensure optimal outcomes. Your commitment to patient well-being and your ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment will be key to your success.

If you are a skilled RN ready to take on an urgent, full-time position with 12-hour shifts and contribute to a supportive care environment, we encourage you to apply today. Join a team dedicated to excellence in patient care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Alabama
Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting preferred
Ability to work 12-hour PM shifts, starting at 1 PM
Strong clinical assessment, documentation, and communication skills
